question: During the Fourth Five-Year Plan, the process of nationalisation of banks took place. How many banks were nationalised during this period?
solution:
The correct answer is __**14**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The process of nationalisation of banks during the Fourth Five-Year Plan (1969-1974) was a significant move in India's banking history.
 
• A total of 14 major commercial banks were nationalised by the Indian government on 19 July 1969.
 
• This move aimed to align banking operations with the economic and social goals of the country, ensuring better control over credit delivery.
 
• The nationalisation targeted banks with deposits of Rs. 50 crores or more, bringing them under the control of the government.
 
• It marked a pivotal step towards the expansion and spread of banking facilities across the rural and semi-urban areas of India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Nationalisation of Banks:**

 
 
• Refers to the process where private sector banks are transferred into public ownership by the government.
 
• The primary objective was to ensure sufficient credit for agriculture, small industry, and exports, and to promote banking habits among the population.
 
 
 
• **Fourth Five-Year Plan (1969-1974):**
 
 
• Focused on growth with stability and progressive achievement of self-reliance.
 
• It aimed at accelerating the process of industrialisation and growth of the agricultural sector.
 
 
 
• **Impact of Nationalisation:**
 
 
• Led to significant branch expansion and increased access to banking services in rural and semi-urban areas.
 
• Facilitated better implementation of government policies and schemes aimed at poverty alleviation and rural development.
 
 
 
• **Subsequent Nationalisation:**
 
 
• A second wave of nationalisation occurred in April 1980, when six more commercial banks were nationalised.
 
• This brought the total number of nationalised banks in India to 20.
